title: Linear presentation of the scalar-extended single chart
statement: Let $R,C$ be commutative rings, $\pi\in R$, $R_2=R/(\pi^2)$, and $d$ polynomial data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation], with $C$ an $R_2$-algebra. Let $B$ be a commutative $R$-algebra and compatible $R_2$-algebra, with $\pi=0$ in $B$, and fix $k<d.r$. Put $Q=R[x_i,z_l]$, $J_k=(f_l-\pi z_l,a_kz_l-\sum_{j\in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-\pi g_{kl}:l<d.m)$, $A=R_2[x_i]/(\overline f_l)$, and $\alpha_k=\overline a_k\in A$. Set $K=B\otimes_{R_2}A[1/\alpha_k]$, and let $\gamma:R[x_i]\to K$ be coefficient reduction followed by quotient, localization, and right tensor inclusion. In $K[z_l]$ set $I_k=(\gamma(a_k)z_l-\sum_{j\in E_k}\gamma(h_{klj})z_j:l<d.m)$. Then $K[z_l]/I_k$ is isomorphic as a $B$-algebra to $(B\otimes_R\operatorname{ULift}(Q/J_k))[1/t]$, where $t=1\otimes[a_k]$. Quotients and algebras are [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], polynomials [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], tensor products [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and localization [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. There is no normalization hypothesis on h.

proof.text: Apply the unlocalized chart presentation to obtain the coefficient-compatible B-algebra equivalence before inverting a_k.

Base change the localization of A at reducedElement to K. The tensor-product localization instance identifies K as a localization of L at beta(a_k). The explicitly constructed tensor map sends beta(p) to singleChartCoefficient(p).

MvPolynomial.isLocalization and the quotient-localization instance identify the polynomial quotient over K by the mapped linear ideal with the localization of the unlocalized polynomial quotient. Mapping every generator proves that the mapped ideal is exactly singleChartLinearIdeal.
Transport localization through the unlocalized equivalence, using its coefficient compatibility at a_k. Compose the quotient identification and the two localization equivalences.

proof_origin.note: P3: complete Lean localization argument; unlocalized scalar extension split off. Uses Mathlib MvPolynomial.isLocalization, IsLocalization quotient instance, tensorProduct_tensorProduct_right and algEquivOfAlgEquiv.

lean.statement: theorem zero_base_single_chart_presentation (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c) [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] (π : R) [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar] (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (B : Type b) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) B] [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) B] (hπ : algebraMap R B π = 0) (k : Fin d.r) : let J : Ideal d.polynomial := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d.m ⊕ Fin d.m ↦ match i with | .inl j => d.equation (.inl j) | .inr l => d.equation (.inr (k, l)))) Nonempty ((MvPolynomial (Fin d.m) (B ⊗[R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)] Localization.Away (d.reducedElement k)) ⧸ d.singleChartLinearIdeal B k) ≃ₐ[B] Localization.Away (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := B) (ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk J (d.includeX (d.a k))))))
